exposure: Trial of labor after cesarean section (TOLAC)
cohort: 6261 women with a prior cesarean delivery who delivered at Korle Bu Teaching Hospital between January 2010 and December 2014
finding: Despite a decreasing trend towards TOLAC and a rising cesarean section rate, there is a significantly high VBAC success rate among carefully selected women undergoing trial of scar in Ghana.
mod_finding: Birth weights of less than 1.5kg, and 3.5Kg or greater were associated significantly with higher incidence failed TOLAC and emergency repeat CS.
